name: sanjeevani-voice
description: Voice-first medical navigation and preliminary triage assistant for India.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @sanjeevani/api" "npm run dev -w @sanjeevani/web"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @sanjeevani/api && npm run build -w @sanjeevani/web
scripts.build:vercel-web: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @sanjeevani/web && npm run check:secrets
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run start -w @sanjeevani/api" "npm run start -w @sanjeevani/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w @sanjeevani/api && npm run typecheck -w @sanjeevani/web
